result.topic_en: Evaluation of the Gaussian double integral of e^{-(x^2+y^2)} by the substitution y = tx followed by u = (1+t^2)x^2.

methods.what: Double integral of the Gaussian function over the plane
Change of variables y = tx in the inner integral (dy = x dt)
Interchange of the order of integration
Substitution u = (1+t^2)x^2, reducing the inner integral to an elementary exponential integral
Result of the inner integration, leaving an integrand 1/(2(1+t^2)) in t
